data.name: Fujair
data.gender_notes: Fujair is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word 'fajr' meaning dawn or morning, and 'ra' meaning mountain. A name evoking strength and victory. The name Fujair carries the meaning “Victorious mountain” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fujair usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Fujair belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fujair total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fujairah holds strong cultural significance within the United Arab Emirates, as it is the name of one of the seven emirates that make up the UAE. It is a name deeply rooted in the history and heritage of the region, and is believed to represent the promise of a new beginning and the triumph of the human spirit over the challenges presented by the desert landscape. The symbolic reference to the dawn or morning evokes feelings of hope and renewal.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Fujairah carries deep spiritual significance as well, as it is a reminder of the importance of the connection between the natural world and the divine. In Islamic tradition, the dawn is a time of contemplation and reflection, a time when one can renew their faith and commit themselves to the path of righteousness. The mountain reference in the name can be seen as a symbol of the undying connection between the human spirit and the Creator, as mountains are often seen as sacred or divine in many cultures and religions. Overall, the name Fujairah serves as a powerful reminder of the beautiful interplay between culture, history, and the spiritual journey of the human soul.
